stack_semantics.physical_binding: AWG26 stack cards are penny-sleeved and held together with sticky-note backing.
stack_semantics.holding_rule: When a card is visible in this stack, MERIDIAN-OTTOBOT holds it in hand and wields or is in charge of the card's most local casting until a later provenance record shows another agent holding it in their stack.
stack_semantics.cross_registry_rule: A held card may also appear in another agent's cards-of or decks-of registry. Stack provenance records current possession/charge; cards-of and decks-of record origin, identity, or acting-as relations.
stack_semantics.import_invariant: DashBOrg importers must create held_by/custody relations from this file and must not infer owner, identity_of, assigned_to, deck_of, or origin provenance from physical containment.
stack_semantics.supersession_rule: Later stack photos or explicit human corrections can supersede the holder without deleting earlier provenance.
